title: Two different holidays
instructions: Ece ve Jack tatillerini karşılaştırıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; hangi bilginin kime ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: Hi Ece! How was your holiday?

script.speaker: ece
script.text: It was wonderful, thanks. I went to Norway with my sister.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: Not really. It was about fifteen degrees. We went hiking in the mountains every day. And you? You went to Egypt, didn't you?

script.speaker: jack
script.text: Yes, I did. It was really hot, nearly forty degrees.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: Wow! What did you do there?

script.speaker: jack
script.text: We visited the pyramids, and we went diving in the Red Sea. The fish were amazing.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: That sounds fantastic. Was it expensive?

script.speaker: jack
script.text: Not very. The hotel was cheap, and food was cheap too. Norway is expensive, isn't it?

script.speaker: ece
script.text: Yes, very. A coffee was six pounds! So we stayed in a tent and cooked our own food.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: In a tent? Brave! Would you go back?

script.speaker: ece
script.text: Definitely. But next time I want to go in winter to see the northern lights.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: I'd like to go back to Egypt, but in spring, when it's not so hot.

questions.prompt: Who did Ece go on holiday with?
questions.feedback: Ece Norveç'e kız kardeşiyle (with my sister) gitti.
questions.evidence: I went to Norway with my sister.

questions.prompt: What was the temperature in Norway?
questions.feedback: Norveç yaklaşık on beş derece. Kırk derece Mısır.

questions.prompt: What did Jack do in Egypt?
options: He visited the pyramids and went diving.
questions.feedback: Jack piramitleri gezdi ve Kızıldeniz'de dalış yaptı. Yürüyüş ve çadır Ece'nin tatili.
questions.evidence: We visited the pyramids, and we went diving in the Red Sea.

questions.prompt: Why did Ece stay in a tent?
questions.feedback: Norveç çok pahalı (bir kahve altı pound); bu yüzden çadırda kaldılar.
questions.evidence: So we stayed in a tent and cooked our own food.

questions.prompt: When does Jack want to go back to Egypt?
questions.feedback: Mısır'a ilkbaharda (in spring) dönmek istiyor, çok sıcak olmadığında. Kış Ece'nin Norveç planı.
questions.evidence: but in spring, when it's not so hot.
